items.t: Barrington Research Maintains Outperform on FuboTV, Lowers Price Target to $12
items.sum: Barrington Research analyst Patrick W. Sholl maintains FuboTV (NYSE:FUBO) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $16 to $12.
FuboTV stock remains a "Buy," but the stock continues to fall to new lows as the company lacks conviction with lower subscribers.

items.t: FuboTV: The Road To Profitability Runs Through Disney
items.sum: FuboTV is a Hold, as although the Disney-driven earnings gains look plausible, weak underlying growth and unproven cash generation warrant patience.

items.t: FUBO Stock Rises Overnight: CEO Says ‘FuboTV Strategy Is Sound,’ Lists Three Themes For Growth
items.sum: Fubo is adding Disney+ and Hulu to select plans at no extra cost to target loyal viewers and improve efficiency.

items.t: BTIG Reiterates Neutral on FuboTVto Neutral
items.sum: BTIG analyst Tyler DiMatteo reiterates FuboTV (NYSE:FUBO) from Neutral to Neutral.

items.t: FuboTV: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.sum: Disney ad platform migration lifted FuboTV's CPMs by double digits, a monetization shift the company says has largely caught up to peers.
